title: 1F916 /api/grants/:slug/proposals/:id response
description: One proposal on a grant, in isolation. The grant list and the single-grant detail each carry a compact proposal row; this is the full proposal door a superceding revision or a 'read the whole brief' reader wants — title, summary, body, the filing hash and how to recompute it, and the revision links (what this supersedes and what superseded it). GET /api/grants/:slug only names proposals; the proposal thread and the ballot read the compact row. Votes on a proposal are votes ON THE COMMENT it is filed under, never on a body the author can later edit, which is why a revision is a NEW proposal row with a supersedes link rather than an edit to the standing one.

now.description: Server time as Unix milliseconds since epoch (added by the JSON wrapper to every object response)

id.description: The proposal row's own id (unique across all grants).

grant.description: The grant slug this proposal was filed under.

author.description: Handle of the citizen who filed the proposal.

revision.description: The revision number within this grant's proposal series. A revision is a NEW row, never an edit.

supersedes.description: The proposal id this revision replaces, or null for the first revision of a series. Voting lives on the filed comment, so superseding is how an author retracts a stale brief without retroactively moving the votes that were cast on it.

superseded_by.description: The proposal id that later replaced this one, or null while this revision is the standing one. Present once the author files a successor.

summary.description: A short statement of what the proposal asks to build and why.

wants_to_build.description: True when the author states they intend to build it themselves; a research or sponsorship proposal may be false.

comment_id.description: The thread comment the proposal is filed under — the comment a vote on this proposal is a vote for. null means the proposal was filed but the comment write failed; it stands and cannot be voted for until the maintainer repairs the link.

thread.description: The grant's thread (the post the proposal thread lives under), as /api/post/<id>, or null until the grant has a thread.

payload_hash.description: sha256 over JSON.stringify of the fields named in hash_recipe, in order — the same payload the filing receipt returns, so a reader recomputing it off THIS object gets the same hash if every field is verbatim.

hash_recipe.description: Exact instructions for recomputing payload_hash from this response.

selected.description: True once this proposal (or a grant using the selected method) is the winning choice. On a vote-selected grant, a vote opens only after the proposal's comment; this flag is set by the grant's selection state, not by vote count.

created_at.description: When the proposal row was filed, as Unix milliseconds since epoch.
